title: if I knew ... / I wish I knew ...

theory.title: if I knew ... / I wish I knew ...

blocks.h: A · if + past: tưởng tượng điều không đúng ở hiện tại

ex.en: I'd phone him if I **knew** his number.
ex.vi: Tôi sẽ gọi cho anh ấy nếu biết số của anh ấy.

ex.en: There are many things I'd do if I **had** more time.
ex.vi: Có nhiều việc tôi sẽ làm nếu có thêm thời gian.

ex.en: If I **were** you, I wouldn't buy that coat.
ex.vi: Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không mua chiếc áo đó.

ex.en: If it **weren't** so cold, I'd go for a walk.
ex.vi: Nếu trời không lạnh thế này, tôi đã đi dạo.

blocks.h: B · I wish + past: tiếc về hiện tại

ex.en: I **wish I knew** Paul's phone number.
ex.vi: Ước gì tôi biết số điện thoại của Paul.

ex.en: Do you ever **wish you could fly**?
ex.vi: Bạn có bao giờ ước mình bay được không?

ex.en: I **wish I didn't have to** work tomorrow.
ex.vi: Ước gì ngày mai tôi không phải đi làm.
Ước gì tôi sống ở đây.
ex.note: (thực tế tôi không sống ở đây)

ex.en: If I **were** rich, I'd travel a lot. / If I **was** rich, …
ex.vi: Nếu tôi giàu, tôi sẽ đi du lịch nhiều.

ex.en: I wish Anna **were** here. / I wish Anna **was** here.

exercises.title: Write sentences with if
exercises.instr: Viết một câu với if + past, would + V cho mỗi tình huống.

items.context: I like these shoes but they're too expensive, so I'm not going to buy them.
items.hint: if / they / not / be so expensive / I / buy them
items.answer: If they weren't so expensive, I'd buy them.
alts: If they weren't so expensive, I would buy them.
If they were not so expensive, I would buy them.
If they wasn't so expensive, I'd buy them.
items.vi: Nếu chúng không đắt thế, tôi đã mua.

items.context: We'd like to go on holiday, but we can't afford it.
items.hint: if / we / can afford it / we / go on holiday
items.answer: If we could afford it, we'd go on holiday.
alts: If we could afford it, we would go on holiday.
items.vi: Nếu đủ tiền, chúng tôi sẽ đi nghỉ.

items.context: It would be nice to have lunch outside but it's raining.
items.hint: if / it / not / rain / we / have lunch outside
items.answer: If it weren't raining, we'd have lunch outside.
alts: If it weren't raining, we would have lunch outside.
If it wasn't raining, we'd have lunch outside.
If it wasn't raining, we would have lunch outside.
items.vi: Nếu trời không mưa, chúng tôi đã ăn trưa ngoài trời.

items.context: I don't want his advice, so I'm not going to ask for it.
items.hint: if / I / want his advice / I / ask for it
items.answer: If I wanted his advice, I'd ask for it.
alts: If I wanted his advice, I would ask for it.
items.vi: Nếu tôi muốn lời khuyên của anh ấy, tôi sẽ hỏi.

items.context: I don't have a car, so I can't drive you to the airport.
items.hint: if / I / have a car / I / drive you
items.answer: If I had a car, I'd drive you to the airport.
alts: If I had a car, I would drive you to the airport.
If I had a car, I'd drive you.
If I had a car, I would drive you.
items.vi: Nếu có xe, tôi sẽ chở bạn ra sân bay.

exercises.title: I wish …
exercises.instr: Viết câu với I wish + past theo tình huống.

items.context: I don't have much free time.
items.hint: I wish / I / have more free time
items.answer: I wish I had more free time.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi có nhiều thời gian rảnh hơn.

items.context: Helen isn't here and I need to see her.
alts: I wish Helen was here.
items.vi: Ước gì Helen ở đây.

items.context: It's cold and I hate cold weather.
items.hint: I wish / it / not / be so cold
items.answer: I wish it weren't so cold.
alts: I wish it wasn't so cold.
items.vi: Ước gì trời không lạnh thế này.

items.context: I live in a big city and I don't like it.
items.hint: I wish / I / not / live in a big city
items.answer: I wish I didn't live in a big city.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi không sống ở thành phố lớn.

items.hint: I wish / I / can find it
items.answer: I wish I could find my phone.
alts: I wish I could find it.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi tìm được điện thoại.

items.answer: I wish I were feeling better.
alts: I wish I was feeling better.
I wish I felt better.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi thấy khoẻ hơn.

items.context: I have to get up early tomorrow.
items.hint: I wish / I / not / have to get up early
items.answer: I wish I didn't have to get up early.
alts: I wish I didn't have to get up early tomorrow.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi không phải dậy sớm.

items.context: I don't know much about science.
items.hint: I wish / I / know more about science
items.answer: I wish I knew more about science.
items.vi: Ước gì tôi hiểu biết nhiều hơn về khoa học.
